capabilities.body: OpenAmer ej karōk jerbal, kōm̧m̧ane kōn kein jerbal ko m̧ool — jikin jeje kōm̧m̧an, kein etale web, file, im code — im kōjparok men ko rar jerbal.
capabilities.title: Juon ri-jipan̄ eo ej ļōmņak ippam

capabilities.body: Bwebwenato ko, kememej im joñak ko rej pād ilo kein jerbal in. Ejjeļo̧k men ej jilkinļo̧k ñan internet ñe kwōjab kajjitōk.
capabilities.title: Kein jerbal eo am̧, meļeļe ko am̧

capabilities.body: 186 kajin, kajjojo ilo wāween jeje eo kwōmaron̄ riiti. Peij eo kein kajuon ilo būrookraam eo ej kajjitōk kajin ta.
capabilities.title: Kajin eo am̧, ilo jimwe

capabilities.body: Māletlet ko rej kōjparok jān jerbal eo make, kōn men in jerbal ko aolep raan rej dikļo̧k ñe kwōkōjerbale ium̧win juon iien aitok.
capabilities.title: Maron̄ eo ej eddekļo̧k

help: Lale bwe kein jerbal in emaron̄ deļo̧ñ internet.
Bar jinoe kōpooj eo — buñten ne ko em̧ōj aer tōprak reban bar kōm̧m̧an.
Ñe ejjab tōprak ruo alen, kōpeļļo̧k laajrak in jerbal ko; lain ko āliktata rej kwaļo̧k etan buñten ne eo.
failure.lead: Ejjeļo̧k oktak em̧ōj karool ilo ettino — OpenAmer ej bōjrak ilo jikin eo ear bōjrak ie, kōn men in bar jinoe ej wōnmaanļo̧k jān ijo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ej pād wōt ilo kōttōpar eo jinoin im ej jerbal wōt. Ejjeļo̧k men em̧ōj ukote jimettan.
failure.title: Kōpooj eo ejjab dedeļo̧k

language.lead: Kōpooj eo ej wōnmaanļo̧k ilo kajin eo kwōj kāāle ilo jikin in. Kwōmaron̄ ukote tokālik ilo būrookraam eo.
language.title: Kāāl kajin eo am̧

progress.lead: Kōpooj juon alen wōt: OpenAmer ej bōk men ko ej aikuj jān internet im kōpooj kein jerbal in. Ñe ej bar jino tokālik, ejjab aikuj bar kōm̧m̧an men kein.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ej ukot kōttōpar eo jinoin. Iien jerbal ko am̧, kememej im karōk ko reban oktak.
progress.title: Ej kōpooj OpenAmer

stages.rebuild: Ej bar kalōk būrookraam eo an kein jerbal in
stages.repository: Ej kōm̧m̧an juon kape in jikin kōjparok eo an OpenAmer

stages.uv: Ej likūt kein lale peekeij eo uv
stages.venv: Ej kōm̧m̧an juon jikin jerbal eo an Python

cards.body: Kōpeļļo̧k būrookraam eo im kōmeļeļeik ta eo kwōkōņaan bwe en kōm̧m̧an. OpenAmer ej jerbal ilikin im ba tok tōprak eo.
cards.title: Jino kōn juon jeje in naan

cards.body: Karōk ko → Kwaļo̧k → Kajin. 186 karōk in kajin im jikin, kwōmaron̄ ukoti jabdewōt iien.
cards.title: Kāāl kajin eo am̧

cards.body: Jerbal eo ej walōk elōñ alen ej erom juon māletlet — ilo alen eo tok juon, ej aikuj juon kōm̧m̧an wōt.
cards.title: Kōtļo̧k bwe en kememej

success.command: ak jinoe tokālik jān juon jikin jeje kōm̧m̧an:
success.errorTitle: Kar jab maron̄ jinoe būrookraam eo an kein jerbal in
success.lead: Aolep men rej pojak. OpenAmer ej am̧ kiiō — ilo kein jerbal in, ilo kajin eo am̧.
success.title: OpenAmer epojāk

bullets: Ej jerbal ilo kein jerbal in — bwebwenato ko am̧ rej pād wōt ilo kein jerbal in
186 kajin, ekoba wāween jeje eo kwōj riiti
Kwōmaron̄ ukot aolep men tokālik; ejjeļo̧k men ej pād ñan indeeo
welcome.lead: Ri-jipan̄ eo am̧ make. Ilo kein jerbal eo am̧. Ilo kajin eo am̧.
welcome.leadUpdate: Juon kōttōpar ekāālļo̧k an OpenAmer epojāk. Ej ukot kōttōpar eo jinoin im kōjparok aolep iien jerbal im karōk.
welcome.note: Ej bōk jejjo minit ilo juon koba ñan internet eo ekkā.
welcome.title: Iakwe im̧aan OpenAmer
